Container.Name: Nestview
Container.Overview: Nestview is a lightweight, self-hosted Docker visibility and health tool for homelabbers. Zero-config autodiscovery of all running containers, a health dashboard, searchable log history, per-container CPU/memory/network stats, Discord alerting, and image update awareness, all from a single container with no manual service configuration required.[br][br] - [b]Default port:[/b] 8484[br] - [b]First run:[/b] A setup wizard will guide you through creating your admin account.[br][br] - [b]Documentation:[/b] https://github.com/kylejschultz/nestview[br] - [b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/UQAZ3bJ6
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: docker monitoring homelab containers health dashboard

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the Nestview web interface.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the Nestview database (SQLite) and configuration.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Access to the Docker socket. Required for container autodiscovery, monitoring, and container restart functionality.

Config.Name: Stats Poll Interval (seconds)
Config.Description: How often Nestview polls Docker for container stats. Leave blank to use the default (10 seconds).

Config.Name: Log Retention (days)
Config.Description: How many days of container log history to keep. Leave blank to use the default (7 days). This value is only read on first run - set it before starting Nestview for the first time if you want a non-default value. Changes after initial setup must be made in the Nestview Settings UI.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for log timestamps and scheduled tasks. Leave blank for UTC. Use a standard tz database name, e.g. America/Chicago or Europe/London.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Set to true if Nestview is behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy (Nginx, Caddy, Traefik). Leave blank otherwise.

Config.Name: Reset Admin Password
Config.Description: Set to true to clear stored credentials and re-trigger the setup wizard on next start. Remove this value and restart the container again after completing setup.
